exposure: perinatal management of extremely preterm births
attendance of a neonatologist at birth
outcome: attendance of a neonatologist at birth
cohort: Women admitted with at least one live fetus and delivered at 22-25 gestational weeks at Karolinska University Hospital Solna, Sweden, during two periods: April 1, 2004-March 31, 2007 and January 1, 2012-December 31, 2016
finding: Despite an increase in obstetric and neonatal interventions for births below 26 gestational weeks between 2004-2007 and 2012-2016, 1-year survival did not increase.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates increased from 14% in 2004-2007 to 45% in 2012-2016.
